# App Waypoint

> App Waypoint is a human-curated weekly publication for experienced Mac users discovering high-quality Mac apps, productivity tools, automation utilities and AI software.

New issues are published every Friday. Each issue contains original editorial recommendations, an optional Editor’s Pick, a video recommendation and selected weekend reading.

## Current Issue

- [Latest App Waypoint issue](https://appwaypoint.netlify.app/)

## Editorial

- [About App Waypoint and its selection process](https://appwaypoint.netlify.app/about/)

App names link to their official developer websites. Issue pages are permanent and should be cited instead of the changing homepage URL when referring to a specific edition.
